861:t_097:6.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Then, $$グーラ$$... We'll show you what makes Super Robot Wars so appealing.」

861:t_097:7.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Player, please come back soon and show $$グーラ$$ how fun Super Robot Wars is, too.」

861:t_098:3.en:
$$勝平$$
「Hey, $$宇宙太$$, and $$恵子$$, too! ...What are you doing?」

861:t_098:4.en:
$$恵子$$
「Honestly! We're saying goodbye because the player is quitting the game!」

861:t_098:5.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「Jeez, you came here without even knowing that?」

861:t_098:7.en:
$$恵子$$
「Hey! $$勝平$$! You too, $$宇宙太$$! ...Sorry, everyone. Get plenty of rest!」

861:t_098:8.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「If you can, start again soon!」

861:t_099:3.en:
$$勝平$$
「An enemy more powerful than ever launches the final and greatest battle...」

861:t_099:4.en:
$$勝平$$
「The $$神ファミリー$$ and their comrades keep resisting, with everyone's hopes behind them.」

861:t_099:5.en:
$$勝平$$
「What lies at the end of that battle is...」

861:t_099:6.en:
$$勝平$$
「Next time, 'Super Robot Wars Forever.' Now, how will we fight through it?」

861:t_099:7.en:
$$勝平$$
「Hehe... Did you hear that, Grandpa? I've really grown up, haven't I...?」

861:t_100:3.en:
$$赤木$$
「What? You're stopping here? I want to know what happens next, too. Let's play a little longer, okay?」

861:t_100:4.en:
$$青山$$
「Don't ask too much of the player. We'd hate working overtime every day, too, right?」

861:t_100:5.en:
$$赤木$$
「Sure, but that's where 'Spirit' and 'Guts' come in!」

861:t_100:6.en:
$$青山$$
「Players, you don't have to let $$赤木$$ talk you into using precious Spirit Commands here.」

861:t_100:7.en:
$$青山$$
「So I'll give you all a 'Bless' and a 'Cheer.'」

861:t_100:9.en:
$$青山$$
「These are for my personal life. ...See you next time, players.」

861:t_100:10.en:
$$赤木$$
「What do you mean, for your personal life...?」

861:t_101:3.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「You're stopping here for now, then? I'll enjoy a little rest myself.」

861:t_101:4.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「But you are the star of this story, after all. There can be no story without its star.」

861:t_101:5.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Just as I keep playing $$ロジャー・スミス$$, I want you to keep playing the leading role.」

861:t_101:6.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Then we must part for a short while. Let us meet again in the world of 'Super Robot Wars.'」

861:t_102:3.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I suppose you and I need a rest soon... Everyone needs rest, and there is something we need to enjoy it...」

861:t_102:4.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Now, R. $$ドロシー#bigo$$... Bring me coffee, please. As I've told you many times, I don't want milk or sugar. I want it black.」

861:t_102:6.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Coffee should be strong and bitter, and conversation with women should be light and sweet... That's how I'd like life to be.」

861:t_102:8.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I'm used to hearing that from human women.」

861:t_103:3.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「I was far too naive... An attack can hit even with odds of 10% or less...!」

861:t_103:4.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「Should I return to my save? No, I can't! Even if I want to, time will not permit it.」

861:t_103:5.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「I'm already out of time... There's no time to go back...! Then the answer I must choose is...!」

861:t_104:3.en:
$$カレン$$
「Oh, um... Thanks for playing. You'll start again soon, right? Otherwise...」

861:t_104:4.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Hey, what kind of farewell is that? You have no charm. You have no sex appeal, either.」

861:t_104:6.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Then I'll show you my secret weapon...」

861:t_104:7.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Um, Master... I'll do anything, so please come back soon!」

861:t_104:9.en:
$$カレン$$
「What!? What was that just now!?」

861:t_105:3.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「A game comes into being... through the actions its player takes.」

861:t_105:4.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「A game moves forward... through the choices its player makes.」

861:t_105:5.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Yes, this game is moving toward its next form.」

861:t_105:6.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Make sure you return so the hands that mark time do not stop...」

861:t_106:3.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Why don't you take off your mask during the intermission, $$ルルーシュ$$?」

861:t_106:4.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「This is how I show my commitment. I decided to live as $$ゼロ$$.」

861:t_106:5.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Try taking a break with a masked man beside you. You couldn't relax even if you wanted to.」

861:t_106:9.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「The player should know what they must do without me saying it...」

861:t_106:10.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「So you've learned to trust others, too. Now I can rest easy.」

861:t_107:3.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「I, $$ルルーシュ・ヴィ・ブリタニア$$, command you!」

861:t_107:4.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「Player, return to the game at once and clear Super Robot Wars as quickly as possible!」

861:t_107:5.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「...That's what I'd like to say, but this is a wish from me, rather than an order through $$ギアス$$.」

861:t_107:6.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「I look forward to seeing you all again. Show me your miracle of victory.」

861:t_108:3.en:
$$モーム$$
「Good work, players. You did great things again this time.」

861:t_108:4.en:
$$桂$$
「It's no picnic for us being worked to the bone, though.」

861:t_108:5.en:
$$モーム$$
「$$桂$$! If you keep complaining, you'll be benched!」

861:t_108:6.en:
$$桂$$
「Please spare me that. The girls will be disappointed if I don't sortie.」

861:t_108:7.en:
$$モーム$$
「That's what he says, so please take good care of $$桂$$ on the next sortie, too.」

861:t_108:8.en:
$$モーム$$
「I'll do my best alongside you and $$桂$$, too. See you next time!」

861:t_109:7.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「You're stopping here. That's a sound decision.」

861:t_109:8.en:
$$キリコ$$
「Rest will give you strength for the next battle.」

861:t_109:9.en:
$$刹那$$
「But we still need your strength.」

861:t_109:11.en:
$$宗介$$
(This is bad... They've said everything I was going to say...)

861:t_110:3.en:
$$クルツ$$
「$$ロックオン$$... You admitted you're not as good a sniper as your brother, right? That means I'm the No. 1 sniper... Okay?」

861:t_110:4.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「I may admit defeat to my brother, but I have no intention of losing to you.」

861:t_110:6.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「That's just what I want.」

861:t_110:7.en:
$$青山$$
「Don't fight among comrades. Besides, if we're going to aim at anything, rather than enemies...」
